installed_login_input_routing.diagnosis: dual-head captures selected exact QMP heads but physical keyboard input omitted the matching input-send-event device/head selector and remained routed to the default console
installed_login_input_routing.input_selection: try only exact ordered arctic_taskbar_gpu head selectors classified as login in their pre-input capture; non-login heads receive no input, while clear, type, submit, and retry remain bound to the accepted selector
installed_login_input_routing.acceptance: unchanged password ROI change must occur on the same selected login head before Return is sent through that selector

installed_login_pointer_focus.diagnosis: exact QMP device/head keyboard routing selected a console but did not prove guest compositor surface focus; the retained login capture showed the pointer outside the password field
installed_login_pointer_focus.focus_action: one selected absolute QMP pointer click inside the exact password field detected on a preclassified login head
installed_login_pointer_focus.presecret_proof: fixed public probe must satisfy the unchanged bounded same-head password ROI change oracle
installed_login_pointer_focus.clear_proof: the same selected head must return to its observed empty ROI before the secret is sent

installed_login_global_pointer.diagnosis: the single unbound QEMU USB tablet consumes absolute coordinates in the guest global desktop space while the selected-head click scaled a head-local coordinate over 1280x720
installed_login_global_pointer.validated_layout: exact arctic_taskbar_gpu head 0 at 0,0 and head 1 at 1280,0 form one gap-free, non-overlapping 2560x720 rectangle
installed_login_global_pointer.pointer_transform: translate the login-head local target and park point by its validated x/y offset, then scale both over the exact global desktop extent
installed_login_global_pointer.privacy_diagnostic: one closed stage code only; no path, pixel, typed value, or private frame

installed_login_split_click.diagnosis: QMP input-send-event synchronizes once after the complete event list, so batching absolute motion, BTN_LEFT down, and BTN_LEFT up exposed only the final released USB HID state to the guest
installed_login_split_click.click_sequence: selected global pointer motion, 0.4 second settle, selected button down, 0.15 second settle, selected button up in three QMP synchronization frames
installed_login_split_click.button_release_cleanup: after button-down send intent begins, the exact selected release is attempted in finally even when the reply is interrupted or rejected; a primary cancellation or failure is preserved

taskbar_mixed_scale_pointer_feedback.failure_policy: invalid cursor feedback, an oversized correction, helper rejection, or non-convergence fails before any visibility observation
